## What does this change help someone do?

Describe the question, relevant input and result someone can use.

## Scope

Link the issue or task that sets the scope, authority and limits. Call out any
decision that is still needed.

## Checks and limits

Identify the candidate you checked, what you ran and what you learned. Say what
remains unchecked or unresolved. Keep prepared work distinct from executed work.

## AI assistance

Name the tools you used, what they contributed and how you reviewed their output.

By submitting, confirm you can explain the change and follow
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
and the project's CC0 contribution terms.
